GetFlag(SHA_Trials_State_TrialInProgress_87772420-50d7-4937-85ec-95c42fd9fd14, S_SHA_ObjectOfDarknessTrial_3892d0a6-24f4-402e-8b51-03ba8cfb4429, 1)
